feed.summary: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited has made available the transcript of the presentation on unaudited financial results for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026. The presentation was delivered on November 5, 2026. The transcript is accessible on the company website at the specified link. This filing is pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46(2) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange with scrip code 508869 and on the National Stock Exchange with scrip code APOLLOHOSP. The ISIN is INE437A01024. The notice was issued on November 11, 2026. S.M. Krishnan, Senior Vice President Finance and Company Secretary, signed the communication.
